[[VIDEOID:78ad761085e65664f01bc24c6df1b5db]] Perfect for misting fragile plants or spraying a naughty Kitten. The mist is very light which is great for plants that tend to droop when getting to wet and the spray is good for getting right at the base of the plant or spraying a cat who's getting into trouble.

Spray bottles did exactly what it was suppose to do... spray liquid. I like that I also got three lids with my bottles. The lids are always the first thing to go. The one thing I didn't like is you can't adjust the spray pattern or amount that comes out, there is only off or full drench.
Waste of money.  Both sprayers stopped working in less than a week. The plastic piece behind the handle gets stuck and I had to keep pulling it out to get it to spray. Ridiculous !
These are Awesome sprayers. Work perfectly for my leave in Conditioner. Will order more.
17oz is he best spray ever and get a lot more water then usual

reviews.t: Great Quality, ideal for so many uses.
reviews.x: Triggers are nice and taught. The overall plastic of the bottles is very thick, much thicker than I imagined. I love the color and they just looks classy. I bought one for my hair (curly hair and it is so much easier to work with if I wet it) and one to spray down my clothing/bedding with lavender oil so far so very good. They even sent an extra sprayer!

I absolutely am amazed at the packaging for these 2 bottles.  Very nice...Everything is just what I need! I even received an extra nozzle! Well done and now I will always buy bottles from this company. I make large batches of bath bombs and shower steamers, so I use these bottles with witch hazel.

I use these for water to touch up my curls - for me and my little one. I’m glad it came with two so we leave one downstairs and one upstairs. They have been reliable and actually look kind of nice for a simple water spray bottle. The mist spray is even and light - just what we needed!

Got these to use as aids with training my cat. One of the spray tops stopped working day two but they included a replacement nozzle so that was good. Could see these being useful for plenty of things. Tho I do not know how they hold up to cleaners but with water they work fine.

reviews.t: Great for covering large areas to clean with far less products.
reviews.x: Great for spray on shower cleaner. Use FAR less product! This spray covers about 4 times what the actual shower cleaner bottles do. As a result, I’m using 3/4 less product and my shower doors and tub are actually cleaner with less product. I highly recommend these bottles.

reviews.x: I didn’t believe there was really 3 spray settings but there is. It’s not like the cheap dollar store ones where you twist and it gives more or less there are actual clicks you clean feel when turning the nozzle. Use it to mix cleaning supplies.
I love the style of the bottles. I am using one to water my plants and the other one I haven't put to use yet.  I like that the bottles came with an extra spraye
Love this spray bottle! Very sturdy bottle, love the nozzle with 3 settings, close/mist/stream, and they all work well. II highly recommend this product!!

reviews.x: these were a little too big but I love them. sprinkler was not giving me mist but I manipulated it and it turned out great. I love it.
Bought 2, very pretty but garbage. Both bottles clogged first use and are impossible to fix. Waste of resources from our planet.

reviews.t: Excellent sprayer, delivers a heavy mist
reviews.x: Excellent sprayer, delivers a heavy mist. I use one to mist my baby sequoia trees and they are very happy about it, lol.
As described- only negative is that the spray and mist options are both mostly mist. There is no "stream"
Needed opaque container. This works. Spray mechanism is not as expected. Works, but not the best spray.

Disappointing. Seems nice that they give you an extra nozzle, but I immediately had to toss one of them because it leaked and dripped all over my hand whenever I sprayed.  Was ok with that because I still had two that worked...a few months later and they are both dripping whenever sprayed, not to mention that not much liquid comes out with each spray.  You’d be better off with a dollar store spray bottle and the quality will likely be superior to these.  The bottle itself seems to be built to la

I rarely leave feedback for inexpensive items, but these are great. I needed them to mist my indoor ferns, which need high humidity. I hadn't been able to find sprayers that didn't splatter and dribble until I found these. These produce an even, fine mist that is perfect for the ferns, and the design is attractive so I can leave them out on the shelf with the plants where they are handy.  Bonus, they included an extra sprayer head!

I didn't read that they were white so I was bummed because I thought they would be clear.  I love their smaller version 4oz clear ones.  One of these I will use for a hair product and 1 for a cleaning product so I don't have a problem remembering what they are.  Just remember to read the product info!  Plus its a great deal for 2 bottles.

reviews.t: Not bad until but the price doubled.
reviews.x: I fill the bottle with Clorox clearer. I knew that the product won't last a long time because Clorox will eat all plastic after a few months. It will last for about 6 months after that the sprayer pump will break down. When i purchased it the price for $2.98 for two bottles. Now the price has doubled.  I may still purchase again .

I love these bottles, it came with an extra nozzle in case the first two breaks. I use it for my plants and to mix cleaning products in. I had these for a few months and so far they are still working great. The bottles look exactly like the ones in the pics (pearly white color with black nozzle).

I love these! I use one fore my liquid hair products and another to spray my bearded dragon daily.  They have worked successfully for over a month.  It has two blocking modes, one soft mist and one firm spray.  They have a nice Pearl finish and a strong plastic feel. It's a win in my book!

claims.text: Many reviewers find these bottles versatile and handy for a wide range of uses, including plants, hair, cleaning, and pets.
Several reviewers praise the sturdy, thick plastic and attractive appearance of the bottles.
Some reviewers report sprayers breaking or stopping working quickly, though a replacement nozzle was appreciated.
Reviewers appreciate the adjustable spray settings and even, light mist.
A few reviewers note the bottles are larger than expected or that the spray pattern isn't adjustable on some units.
